channel.title: Daily Silicon Bytes
channel.description: The tech news that actually moved something: deals, earnings, filings, launches and the rules that shape them. Two hosts, five stories, about five minutes, every weekday morning. Every figure comes from a filing or a named outlet, never from memory.
